title: Foam plastic as trim.
officialText: Foam plastic used as trim shall be permitted in Group R-3 occupancies, within individual dwelling units of Group R-1 and R-2 occupancies, and where approved in accordance with the special provisions of Section 2603.9. Foam plastics used as trim in any occupancy shall comply with the requirements of Section 2604.2.
